name: Crimson Wars
summary: Crimson Wars is a 1999 real-time strategy game set on a futuristic, colonized Mars. It was released by Infogrames on a CD-ROM along with three bonus games: Backgammon, Diagonal of Aces, and Mini Golf. The bundle was marketed as being online-enabled, prominently featuring the title The Internet Games. In Crimson Wars, up to four people could join the same game as opposing factions and chat with each other using an in-game text chat feature.
